title: LeapStart
tagline: Decentralised kickstarter for creators. All-in-one solution to start and scale your IP ambitions.
description: This project is a decentralised kickstarter where user can back their favorite IP projects via IP tokens or NFTs, while NFT stands for the exclusive content or the licensing for commercial usage right of the content, which is empowered by the "Can't Be Evil" NFT Licensing Framework by A16Z crypto labs.
how_its_made: This project is made of solidity and react, web3.js etc. We have adopted solution from sponsors including: Superfluid, to help streaming the funded money to be sent to the project team based on different rules, to help reducing the risk of rug-pull; Polygon which to help us reduce the gas consumption for users; IPFS & FILECOIN, we adopted NFT.storage to help storing the metadata for persistence.
